name: Aidells Chicken & Apple Smoked Sausage (Pork-Free)
whyItWorks: Made from smoked chicken breast and dried sweet apples in a natural casing, completely free from pork fat, gluten, and spicy peppers. Mild, savory-sweet, and significantly lower in fat than pork sausage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice into 1/2-inch rounds and brown in a skillet for 5 minutes. Serve with white rice or mashed potatoes.
